notes.title: GAMEMODES & BUGFIXES !
notes.content:
- Gamemodes has been added to the game:
[list]
[*] EASY
[*] NORMAL
[*] HARD
[*] NIGHTMARE
[/list]

- Also special gamemodes:

[list]
[*] SMOOTHEST CRIMINAL
[*] FEARLESS
[*] HARDCORE
[/list]

Some minor bugfixes to the main game AND MAJOR bugfixes to "The Summoning" DLC, specially in Chapter 3, where the sentinels and cultists were totally broken lol.

- Final Ayuwoki boss-fight of the DLC has been improved, now the morphed cultists react to where you are instead of a timed "eclosion".

- Timings of the boss-fight were also polished.

- ** A MAJOR CHANGE: One of the endings has been drastically changed (DLC) **
- Checkpoint added to final boss fight.
- Now when the Ayuwoki boss eats you, you simply die.
- MODEL VIEWER for DLC has been added. Unlock models by getting steam achievements.

- ** To unlock the special game modes you need to complete the game in NIGHTMARE mode (probably this will change in the next update)**

- Minor bug fixes in Chapter 2 (DLC) regarding voice lines.

notes.title: UPDATE 1.4 !
notes.content:
First of all, Thank you so much for all the support! it has been a great year of hard working and growing as indie game devs and human beings :) we are happy to announce this big update to the game, which also brings a new DLC expansion for all of you! :)

- New checkpoints system (multiple checkpoints per level)
- Hidespots are back! (tables around the mansion has been added).
- "Hold-your-breath" mechanic has been discarded.
- Bug fixes here and there.
- Chapter 3/Cave zone has been re-done.
- Chapter 2/Clock puzzle now is more complete, there are clues about the random time to set and a fixed location to get the white ke.
- Graphics and visuals has been re-calibrated.
- Missing items bug has been fixed.
- Particles performancce has been improved.
- Overrall the core of the project has been modified to be "modable" (we needed that to be able to actually make the DLC), so this open up endless posibilities.
- New HUD indicator for when you are "hidden" in the bottom-left corner :)
- A lot of other minor stuff i actually forgot about lol.

Stay tuned for more news/updates and don't forget to check out our brand new DLC expansion "The Summoning" :) !
